heuristics: None for the success probability: k1 is uniform over [0,N) (the d-th power map is exactly d-to-1 onto the order-N subgroup); block j covers exactly the m values {(m1*j + i) mod N : i < m} with consecutive arcs disjoint (start spacing m1 > m, no start collisions for window spans), so EVERY offset drawn by the sampler covers at least (m-1)m/N >= 0.4 - 2^-118 >= 0.39 k1 values including all wrap-around hits - an exact per-offset bound that holds regardless of the sampler's law; the closed form is crosschecked against an exhaustive every-offset brute force on five smaller parameter sets; the factorization is deterministic on the fixed public input and no probabilistic quantity appears anywhere in the claim.

All table machinery is deterministic with worst-case upper bounds enforced by assertion in the experiment, and every instruction allowance is either an executed construction or carries full limb-level line items: merge sort over an auxiliary buffer (<= m*117 key compares at 15 instructions; <= m*118 record moves at 50 instructions including the copy-back; <= 16 instructions key preparation per record: <= 7671 instructions per baby); binary search (exactly floor(log2 m)+1 = 117 probes worst case, each <= 32 instructions: 2-word midpoint 6, loads 4, six-limb key load/compare 12, parity bit 2, interval update/termination/branches 8); the STREAMING fixed-base comb (giant scalars generated and consumed in blocks of 2^24, never materialized as an m-sized list; each block's accumulator array allocated for exactly the block size; each block's points searched immediately and discarded; 32 window additions per 255-bit scalar, each exactly one reference batched-incomplete-affine operation by the cost model's definition, one Montgomery batched inversion per window layer per block; live working storage itemized at 304 B/record - scalars 32, accumulators 96, prefix products 48, inverse-output 48, pending entries 72, indices 8 - charged at <= 512 B/record x 2^24 = <= 2^33 bytes, stated consistently in every file; the toy executes the construction with live_accs = live_scalars = 64 asserted and equality to plain double-and-add asserted for every point); the 512-instruction mod-r multiplication (explicit 5x52 schoolbook + Montgomery construction); and the deterministic hard-capped counted Brent-Pollard rho factorization of the fixed public r-1 (pre-batch-enforced 2^17-iteration cap, hard 12-cycle guard, measured 111,717 modular multiplications / 310 gcds / 9 cycles) whose every gcd is an EXECUTED round-counted binary gcd with BULK trailing-zero removal (in place of math.gcd, verified against it on 201 sampled pairs plus six adversarial power-of-two pairs - gcd(2^100, 1) costs exactly 2 rounds; NO data-dependent one-bit shift loops: every round is constant work - 4-limb compare <= 10, subtraction <= 10, ONE bulk tz-detect <= 12 (the hardware count-trailing-zeros model), ONE bulk multiword shift <= 10, control <= 8 = <= 50 instructions; the round counter includes every subtraction+strip pair and the <= 3 initial bulk strips, asserted <= 520 rounds per call: <= 26,000 instructions per gcd; measured maxima 154 rounds production, 253 adversarial), with the joint worst case three bounded terms: main loop 12 x 2^17 x 1056 = 2^30.629357 instructions, batched gcds 12 x 2^10 x 26,000 = 2^28.251187, backtrack <= 128 steps/cycle x 26,512 = 2^25.279320, total 2,021,154,816 = 2^30.912533 instructions = 2^19.946748 units, plus certification 2^10.60 and comb tables 2^15.579: preprocessing total <= 2^20.02 units inside the 2^21 budget (every figure computed programmatically); the window offset is drawn by a BOUNDED REJECTION-FREE sampler - U uniform in [0, 2^237), o = (U*M) >> 237, one 512-instruction multiplication and a shift, charged in the ledger, no rejection loop and no failure branch; the law is NOT claimed uniform (exactly uniform only if M divides 2^237, which it does not): each offset receives floor(2^237/M) or ceil(2^237/M) of the 2^237 values of U, a relative deviation below 2^-119 from 1/M, and the per-offset-exact coverage bound makes the law's exact shape immaterial to the success bound.
limitations: Analytic construction; no production-size execution is claimed or possible.
Single-shot randomized attack at the 0.39 threshold; deterministic full coverage costs about +0.86 log2.
The bound applies only for n >= 2^20; smaller n would force a smaller divisor of r-1.
